en: Colorized vintage view of a large stone arch bridge spanning a deep green valley with a stream below. The bridge has multiple arches, with a dominant central arch and smaller ones on each side, and connects tree‑covered slopes and masonry fortification walls. In the distance are buildings on the plateau. Red printed text along the top identifies the scene as Luxembourg and specifies the bridge's dimensions; additional publisher information is printed vertically at the left edge.
